comment: LiDAR-grade terrain models served from Mapterhorn (coverage.py). A source is allowed when it is a bare-earth terrain model (DTM/DGM/MNT/DMR, checked in Mapterhorn's source-catalog file lists) at 2.5 m or finer. Copernicus GLO-30 (a surface model) and 5-10 m compilations are never allowed: outside the mask the Worker answers from AWS Terrarium. A new fine source Mapterhorn adds inside a bbox is logged by `dem.py mask` for review and stays out until listed here.

pendingValidation.comment: LiDAR-grade terrain models in the bbox left out — AWS Terrarium answers there — until each is cross-checked against its agency's own height service or benchmarks (DEM-VALIDATION.md, geodesy rule): validate.py needs a site for it and the results in DEM-VALIDATION.md; then move the id into sources and regenerate the credits. chzh: 0.25 m off swissALTI3D on average at Uetliberg (RMS 0.57 m). frrgealti1metro: partly photogrammetric in the mountains; 3.7 m below IGN's LiDAR HD at Briançon.
